prompt:
Create a 30-second, 16:9, 24fps photoreal cinematic travel fashion MV set in Chongqing, China.
CORE CONCEPT:
A fictional Korean K-pop-style young woman spends one day exploring Chongqing while listening to music through white wired earphones. The whole film feels like a stylish Korean travel vlog mixed with a youth music video — fresh, effortless, lively, and cinematic, never like a tourism commercial.
CHARACTER LOCK:
One woman only, age 20–23, Korean idol visual: small refined face, fair natural skin, long black hair with soft wispy bangs, deep brown eyes, subtle aegyo-sal, thin eyeliner, glossy nude-pink lips, slim figure.
Keep exactly the same face, hair, body proportions, makeup, and identity in every shot.
White wired earphones remain visible throughout.
No dialogue. Emotion is shown through eye contact, small smiles, walking, turning back, laughing, and moving naturally to the music.
WARDROBE:
Day: cream cropped knit top, light-blue high-waisted jeans, silver earrings, black shoulder bag.
Sunset: fitted pale blue-gray top, black cropped jacket, jeans.
Night: black camisole, oversized black jacket, silver jewelry.
Outfit changes only on hard cuts.
TIMELINE:
0–3s: Extreme close selfie at a riverside viewpoint. Chongqing skyline and bridge softly blurred behind. She puts one earbud in, music starts, she smiles at camera.
3–6s: Follow shot on a steep Chongqing hillside street. Layered buildings, slopes, trees, sunlight through leaves. Hair and earphone cable move naturally.
6–9s: Liziba. Low angle as the monorail passes through the residential building. She looks up, then turns back and smiles.
9–12s: Yangtze River Cableway. She stands near the window, looking over the river, bridges, towers, and steep city layers. Wind moves her hair and earphone cord.
12–15s: Old hillside street / Shancheng Trail / Shibati. Stone stairs, old buildings, lanterns, small shops. She walks upward and glances back at camera.
15–18s: Fast lifestyle montage: shoes on stone steps, hand on railing, buying a drink, hair in the wind, tall buildings framed between narrow streets.
18–22s: Sunset overlook. Switch to LOOK 2. Wide skyline, river and bridges in warm orange light. Start from her back, then side profile. She closes her eyes briefly and listens.
22–26s: Hongya Cave at night. Switch to LOOK 3. Warm golden lights, deep blue sky, real crowds. Shoot casually like a friend following her. She looks back, laughs, and keeps walking.
26–30s: Riverside night near Qiansimen Bridge. A female friend joins. They casually bounce, turn, laugh and move to the beat — not formal choreography. The lead walks closer, removes one earbud, looks back at the glowing city.
Final text:
CHONGQING
FOLLOW THE SOUND.
CAMERA:
24mm city wides, 35–50mm portraits, 85mm details. Gentle handheld, walking follow, selfie framing, slow push-ins, natural low angles. Hard cuts motivated by action.
REALISM:
Real skin texture, natural hair physics, stable earphone cable, realistic Chongqing architecture, monorail, cableway, crowds, river and slopes.
NEGATIVE:
No face drift, duplicate character, random wardrobe change, missing earphones, warped hands, plastic skin, cyberpunk Chongqing, Japanese or Korean streets replacing Chongqing, fake landmarks, random text, subtitles, watermark, excessive beauty filtering.
FINAL FEEL:
A Korean K-pop girl’s first day in Chongqing — music in her ears, the whole city moving like her own MV.

translations.zh:
创作一部时长30秒、16:9比例、24fps的中国重庆写实电影感旅行时尚MV。
核心概念：
一位虚构的韩国K-pop风格年轻女子戴着白色有线耳机听着音乐探索重庆的一天。整部片子像一部时尚的韩国旅行Vlog与青春音乐视频的结合——清新、随性、充满活力且富有电影感，绝不像旅游宣传片。
角色锁定：
仅一名女性，年龄20–23岁，韩国偶像外貌：精致小脸、白皙自然肤色、留有柔和空气刘海的黑色长发、深棕色眼睛、微凸卧蚕、细眼线、光泽裸粉色嘴唇、纤细身材。在每个镜头中保持完全一致的容貌、发型、身材比例、妆容和身份。白色有线耳机在整个过程中始终可见。无对白。通过眼神接触、浅笑、漫步、回头、大笑以及随音乐自然律动来传达情绪。
服饰：
白天：米色短款针织上衣、浅蓝色高腰牛仔裤、银色耳环、黑色单肩包。
日落：合身灰浅蓝色上衣、黑色短款夹克、牛仔裤。
夜晚：黑色吊带背心、宽大黑色夹克、银色饰品。仅在硬切镜头时更换服装。
时间线：
0–3秒：滨江观景点的极近自拍。重庆天际线和桥梁在背景轻微虚化。她戴上一只耳机，音乐响起，她对着镜头微笑。
3–6秒：重庆陡峭山坡街道的跟拍镜头。层次分明的建筑、斜坡、树木、穿过树叶的阳光。头发和耳机线自然摆动。
6–9秒：李子坝。单轨穿过居民楼时的低角度镜头。她仰头看去，随后转过头微笑。
9–12秒：长江索道。她站在窗边，俯瞰江水、桥梁、高楼与陡峭的城市层次。风吹拂着她的头发和耳机线。
12–15秒：老山城步道/十八梯。石阶、老建筑、灯笼、小店。她拾级而上，回头看向镜头。
15–18秒：快节奏生活剪辑：踩在石阶上的鞋、扶在栏杆上的手、买饮料、风中飘动的发丝、夹在狭窄街道间的高楼。
18–22秒：日落俯瞰点。切换至造型2。温暖橙光下的宽阔天际线、河流与桥梁。从她的背影开始，随后转为侧脸。她短暂闭上眼睛静听。
22–26秒：夜晚洪崖洞。切换至造型3。温暖金色灯光、深蓝夜空、真实人群。如同朋友跟随抓拍般自然随意拍摄。她回头、大笑并继续漫步。
26–30秒：千厮门大桥附近的滨江夜景。一位女性朋友加入。她们随意随节拍弹跳、转身、欢笑律动——非正式编舞。女主角走近，摘下一只耳机，回头望向璀璨的城市。
结尾文字：
CHONGQING
FOLLOW THE SOUND.
运镜：
24mm城市全景、35–50mm人像、85mm细节。柔和手持、走动跟拍、自拍构图、缓慢推进、自然低角度。动作驱动的硬切。
写实感：
真实皮肤质感、自然头发物理效果、稳定的耳机线、写实的重庆建筑、单轨、索道、人群、江流与斜坡。
负向提示：
无面部漂移、重复角色、随机换装、耳机缺失、扭曲的手、塑料感皮肤、赛博朋克重庆、日式或韩式街道替代重庆、虚假地标、随机文字、字幕、水印、过度美颜滤镜。
最终氛围：
一位韩国K-pop女孩在重庆的第一天——耳中流淌音乐，整座城市宛如她专属的MV。
